_comment: Read by .claude/hooks/enforce-focus.sh. Only the maintainer changes this file. See docs/decisions/0009-mac-app-first-windows-paused.md.
message: Windows development is paused until the maintainer finishes the macOS app (decision 0009). Do not edit windows/. Work on the macOS app, core/ or web/ instead. Only the maintainer can lift the pause by editing .claude/project-focus.json.
